output.summary: Poisonous woodland perennial found across much of Europe and in Algeria, Iran, Turkey and the Caucasus. It spreads by underground stems to form dense carpets in shady woodland and beneath hedges, and bears inconspicuous green flowers from late winter into spring.
output.edibilityNote: All parts are highly poisonous; eating it has caused severe illness and a recorded death, even after boiling and frying.
